answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 16 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 579 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The wharf test is the live device, the comet test is the locked stake, and the prism test is the graded history no template can fake.
